import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate a tile for the data
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy data from HBM to SBUF tile
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Reshape and transpose the data
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):
        for i in nl.affine_range(F1):
            for j in nl.affine_range(F2):
                tile[i, j] = x[p, i * F2 + j]
    
    # Transpose the tile
    for i in nl.affine_range(F2):
        for j in nl.affine_range(F1):
            out[p, j * F2 + i] = tile[i, j]
    
    return out

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate a tile for the data
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Copy data from HBM to SBUF tile
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Reshape and transpose within the tile
    # We need to handle the 2D transpose within the tile
    # First, reshape the tile to (F1, F2) and transpose
    # Then reshape back to (F2, F1)
    # We need to loop over the partition dimension and transpose each matrix
    
    # Loop over the partition dimension
    for p in nl.affine_range(P):
        # Copy the row from HBM to SBUF
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[p:p+1, :])
        
        # Reshape the tile to (F1, F2)
        tile_view = tile.reshape((F1, F2))
        
        # Transpose the tile
        transposed = tile_view.transpose()
        
        # Reshape back to (F2, F1)
        transposed_view = transposed.reshape((F2, F1))
        
        # Copy the transposed data back to HBM
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[p:p+1, :], src=transposed_view)
    
    return out
